turnLimitScope: One ACP prompt; cancel/stop on any tool-call or client permission request. Top-level --max-turns is not forwarded to the agent branch in the inspected official source.
prompt:
Review sanitized implementation metadata only; no tools/web. RealBud local preparation needs preview bound to plan/instruction hashes, agency/source review, worker profile and online claim. Mutation epoch increments before agency/config/pack/recipe changes, Desk commits and connector invalidation. Async checks stamp captured epoch; synchronous enqueue rejects epoch changes. Broad POST /connected-apps/* also incremented on /check, so observation-only UI refresh killed concurrent morning work. Proposed website epoch excludes ONLY POST /connected-apps/check; all mutation fences remain. /check calls cache.refresh(cfg): config snapshot, pending-check dedup, generation increment on invalidation, late old-generation results rejected. Failed checks replace success with unavailable state; cache expires after five minutes. Agency readiness requires exact active Gmail account, fresh cache, reviewed source/settings and plan. Adapter capture checks agency snapshot twice around awaited instructions, captured epoch, cfg/profile and recipe digests. Before mail collection, authorize refreshes access, repeats website binding check and requires current agency review. After scan, collector authorizes again and compares account/settings/source digest. Managed provider checks current tenant/device/account/billing on each call. Generic preparation exposes file/web tools, not mail access. Revocation cannot undo already started effects.
Give top 3 concrete residual race/authority tests for the narrow exclusion. Distinguish config mutations from changed observations: must observing revoked/wrong-account access fence previously validated preparation? Specify causal interleavings. JSON {"cases":[{"title":"...","setup":"...","assertions":["..."]}]} exactly 3 cases, max 4 assertions each, under 280 words. Advice only, not test evidence.
authentication: Existing cached auth via opaque symlink in disposable private GROK_HOME; harness never opens auth contents.

cases.title: Revoked check fences mail, not epoch
cases.setup: Prep at epoch E with hashes H, profile P, recipe R, fresh Gmail A. Worker W holds E. POST /connected-apps/check then sees A revoked or account B.
assertions: E is unchanged, so W stays enqueued and its stamped epoch still matches.
Refresh stores unavailable, bumps generation, and readiness loses exact account and fresh success.
Pre-mail authorize refreshes access, rechecks binding and review, and withholds mail; generic prep stays file/web.
Prior effects stay; no new mail starts.

cases.title: Check splits the two agency snapshots
cases.setup: Adapter saves S0 (A success, E, cfg/profile/recipe digests) and awaits instructions. /check writes revoked A or B at G+1. Late G success returns. Then pre-scan authorize, scan, post-scan compare.
assertions: The second snapshot mismatches, so mail does not start from S0.
Late G success cannot replace unavailable.
If scan started, post-scan account/settings/source compare drops the batch; started effects remain.
Dedup must not apply an older pending success after the newer revocation.

cases.title: TTL observation versus config mutation
cases.setup: Valid prep, T0 success cache (five minutes), epoch E. A: /check same account still success. B: /check wrong or revoked account before expiry. C: pack, recipe, agency, config, Desk commit, or connector invalidation; no /check.
assertions: A keeps E and does not stop other work with the same H, P, and R.
B keeps E, but mail authorize fails; T0 success must not outlive that observation.
C bumps E before visibility; enqueue of E is rejected; async work stamped E ignores the new cfg.
Provider rechecks tenant, device, account, and billing, so B fails with no epoch change.
